status: FROZEN at the commit that first adds this file, after amendment 4 and BEFORE any stage-3 compute and any observed joint statistic. It freezes the joint-test design of the inference branch and its stage-3 design pilot. Production ensembles (calibration, size, power) run only after an independent admission review and the admission record (amendment 6) that prices them. Executor choices under the delegation.
estimator: configuration 1 = R (amendment 4), 5 iterations, npz path, negweight-refined with the refinement refit per experiment
joint_cells: the 109 supported cells of partition J (RD1's joint part; cell integrals over the fine grid, cm^2/nucleon); a joint-5D test at this coarse resolution, not a validation of any fine bin
prediction_notes: the four external predictions are the gen5d build (state/s5p/gen5d/README-gen5d-build.md): truth-level, the analysis's E_avail, Getq3True q3 and the existing converters' W (differs from CVUniverse's struck-nucleon W for ~0.15% of events)
GENIE_2_12_10_MEC uses the 3D normalization convention (KNOWN_ISSUES 81: the committed (E_avail,W) file is 2.87% low; the 5D build is not)
GiBUU_2019 is empty above E_nu ~ 20 GeV (KNOWN_ISSUES 82): its tests use only the J cells with p_parallel < 6 GeV/c (domain 'pz_lt_6'; the pz index of the cell <= 1)
MnvTune_v1 is the analysis MC's own truth (s5p_mc_truth_pred.py) and the unfolding prior; its null is recorded as such
nulls: H0(G) for each of the five predictions: the true J-cell cross sections equal G's. Pseudo-data truth: the analysis MC truth reweighted by rho_c = G_c / MnvTune_c on the supported J cells (rate kept; rho = 1 in unsupported cells, which stay in the unfolding domain; files state/s5p/ratios/nullsJ/null-<g>-J.json); within-cell shapes are MnvTune v1's (declared conditioning)
tests: per null: total (T_total = r' W^-1 r) and shape-only (T_shape, normalized over the test domain, rank-one constraint removed by dropping one cell); family = 5 nulls x 2 = 10 tests; claims of rejection use Holm at familywise 0.05; raw and Holm-adjusted p reported
metric: W = V + diag Var(mu_G): V the Ledoit-Wolf-shrunk covariance of the 200-experiment MnvTune-null pilot ensemble (with every nuisance draw and surrogate below), built by s5p_joint.py build-v and committed before any calibration ensemble; Var(mu_G) the prediction's finite-MC variance per cell. W sets power only; validity comes from the calibration

nuisance_model.event_level_draws: per null experiment (s5p_nullexp.py), applied to the pseudo-data source only: one PPFX flux universe (uniform over the bank's 100); one non-flux vertical universe applied to the background source weights (background-model prior); each weight-only detector band (MinosEfficiency, GEANT_Neutron/Pion/Proton) at a random -1 or +1 sigma endpoint
nuisance_model.surrogates: added to the unfolded J cells (s5p_joint.py): lateral bands sum_b z_b Delta_b with Delta_b = half the difference of the real-data unfolds of the band's two selection-complete endpoints (a linear-response surrogate; its symmetry check (f+ - f0) vs -(f- - f0) is reported and not used to select anything); flat normalization x (1 + 0.014 z); the data's rounding-scale noise N(0, diag s_num^2) from the 20 real-data jitters (the pseudo-data are 20x less chaotic than the data, study N); the prediction's finite MC as -eps, eps ~ N(0, Var(mu_G))
nuisance_model.interpretation: nuisance-AVERAGED (prior-predictive) calibration over the flux, background-model, detector and lateral priors; NOT a uniform composite-null guarantee. Conditional on the MC detector response per event, the MnvTune within-cell shapes and the half-MC pseudo-experiment construction (each experiment unfolds with half the MC at weight x2, the real data with the full MC; the null spread therefore includes more MC-statistical variation than the data's, which is conservative in that respect)
nuisance_model.GENIE_knobs: not nuisances of a generator null (the null fixes the signal physics)

calibration.p_value: (k + 1) / (B + 1) with the exact 95% Clopper-Pearson interval of k / B; the smallest reportable p is 1/2000 as a one-sided bound; never p = 0
calibration.precision: B = 1999 meets T7 over 0.01 <= p <= 1 (half-width <= 0.05 for p >= 0.05, <= 0.5 p for 0.01 <= p < 0.05); below 0.01 a one-sided bound; an interval straddling 0.05 or 0.01 is reported as undetermined at that level
calibration.seeds: stage-7 calibration range: null i uses 1200000 + 20000 i ... + 1998 (i = 0 MnvTune, 1 GENIE CV, 2 GENIE MEC, 3 NuWro, 4 GiBUU)

validity_route: empirical (not the finite-sample route: the real data are not generated by the pseudo-experiment process, so exchangeability is not claimed). Size check (T6): independent validation ensembles of 300 null experiments at the MnvTune and NuWro nulls (stage-7 validation seeds 1400000...), rejection fraction at alpha = 0.05 with the one-sided 95% upper bound <= 0.08; the data-versus-pseudo process differences are stated, not certified

power.construction: each alternative applied on top of the MnvTune-null truth, amplitudes a = 1 and 0.5, 200 experiments each (stage-7 validation seeds 1450000...), with the same nuisance draws and surrogates
power.criterion: T6: shape-test power >= 0.80 at alpha = 0.05 against the MnvTune null's calibration ensemble at a = 1 for each of P1, P2, P3 (the alternatives preserve the in-grid total, so the shape test is the relevant one; total-test power reported); the 95% interval is reported; low power is a limitation, never agreement
power.outside_null: P1-P3 change the signal truth, which no nuisance of the null family varies; their distinguishability after detector response and nuisances is exactly what the power measures

pilot.purpose: the V ensemble; development power of P1-P3 at a = 1 (50 each) to confirm the design is not powerless before production; the lateral endpoint inputs
pilot.lateral_unfolds: the ten real-data endpoint unfolds (R on each lateral npz with its own background dump) are a table added after the dumps, when their digests exist

data_informed_choices: the observed data and the high-E_avail/high-W generator deficit are known; the joint test is not blind
the J partition, the generator list and the alternatives were fixed before any observed joint statistic; the family and Holm rule are fixed here
P1 and P3 were observed as development departures (s5e W3/W2); they are named physics directions for power, not validation truths

costs.production_cpu_equivalent_node_h: calibration 5 x 1999 + size 2 x 300 + power 6 x 200 = 11,795 experiments at ~330 s (incl. nuisance loading) -> ~1,080 step-hours -> ~135 CPU node-h, ~170 with packing; placed on both pools at the admission (amendment 6)
costs.available: CPU unallocated 189.6 after this revision; GPU unallocated 74.7 GPU node-h (~37 CPU-equivalent)

not_admitted: the measurement branch (amendment 4); no measurement construction, validation or adoption is part of this design
